results.query: how often do goldendoodles need grooming

A slicker brush and a metal comb work well. Pay extra attention to the ears, chest, and legs, where mats tend to sneak in. - **Bathing:** Every four to six weeks - **Nails:** Every 3-4 weeks. If you hear clicking on the floor, a trim is overdue. **Puppies:** Start them on grooming early, around 12–16 weeks, to build good habits. If your doodle is very active or swims a lot, you may need to book grooming more often.

results.answer: Yes. Dogs can generally eat quinoa if it's cooked plain and you give it in small amounts. It's even an ingredient in some high-quality dry dog foods. **How to serve it safely:** - **Rinse it before cooking.** Quinoa has a natural coating called saponin that can cause irritation in the intestines.
